mechanisms.controller: monotone pure pursuit and bounded speed servo; gap feedback for trucks; reverse gear controller for backing

unconfirmed.requirement: Supply physically matched inventory for explicit sub/at/above80-inch width-class probes and validate goods-transport truck assets.
unconfirmed.evidence: CARLA blueprint inventory unavailable; existing exact-width class sweep is explicitly incomplete and default native truck dimensions are gated at runtime.
unconfirmed.next_action: Query actual truck blueprints and measured bounding-box widths; supply matched assets for statutory width boundary coverage, retaining gap triple and heavy_vehicle_driver.

measurement_plan.source: original-frame PipelineCapture + actor telemetry; never requested targets as observation
measurement_plan.finalization: Shared validate_output requires actual non-null channels, four decodable 20Hz encoded WebM videos, original trace/frame joins, native setup receipts, measured targets, participant/body histories and recomputable original-window summaries. Missing native assets or failed physical realization retain explicit diagnostics; no legal labels.

rel.surface_gap.method: world-space measured bounding-box projections along ego heading

sight_distance.minimum_from_either_appro.method: minimum actual any-of-nine body horizon across both native incoming directions

backing_intersection_overlap.method: same original frame actual reverse velocity and footprint/region intersection; no legal contact convention chosen

backing_crosswalk_overlap.method: same original frame actual reverse velocity and footprint/native-crosswalk intersection; no legal contact convention chosen

limitations: Physical legal/judgment conclusions remain unresolved; synthetic authored jurisdiction and authority contexts retain provenance.

static_checks: --check validates source syntax, map XML, inline materialization, coverage and camera settings
unittest validates controller sign/overshoot, windowed raw recomputation, map shape and implementation reuse

termination_rules.completion: native route final point reached within 2m engineering tolerance
termination_rules.cleanup: stop/destroy owned sensors and actors; close recorder/capture; restore saved world settings; never stop simulator server
termination_rules.failures: nonzero code 2 for any unresolved setup, target, physical, capture or video requirement
